tools.name: webcrm_search_persons
tools.description: Search persons (contacts) by free text such as a name, e-mail or phone. GET /Persons/Search.

tools.name: webcrm_list_persons
tools.description: List persons (contacts), one page at a time. Use webcrm_search_persons to find one. GET /Persons.

tools.name: webcrm_get_person
tools.description: Get one person (contact) by id. GET /Persons/{id}.

tools.name: webcrm_list_organisations
tools.description: List organisations (companies), one page at a time. GET /Organisations.

tools.name: webcrm_get_organisation
tools.description: Get one organisation (company) by id. GET /Organisations/{id}.

tools.name: webcrm_list_opportunities
tools.description: List sales opportunities, one page at a time. GET /Opportunities.

tools.name: webcrm_get_opportunity
tools.description: Get one sales opportunity by id. GET /Opportunities/{id}.

tools.name: webcrm_list_opportunities_by_pipeline_level
tools.description: List opportunities at one pipeline level (use webcrm_list_pipelines for the level ids). GET /Opportunities/ByPipelineLevel/{pipelineLevel}.

tools.name: webcrm_list_activities
tools.description: List activities (tasks, calls and meetings), one page at a time. GET /Activities.

tools.name: webcrm_get_activity
tools.description: Get one activity by id. GET /Activities/{id}.

tools.name: webcrm_list_activity_notes
tools.description: List the notes (history) of one activity. GET /Activities/{id}/Notes.

tools.name: webcrm_create_activity
tools.description: Create a new activity (task, call or meeting) on a person, organisation or opportunity. POST /Activities. Creates a record: no existing data is changed.

tools.name: webcrm_add_activity_note
tools.description: Add a note to an existing activity. POST /Activities/{id}/Notes. Creates a note: no existing note is changed.

tools.name: webcrm_list_events
tools.description: List events, one page at a time. GET /Events.

tools.name: webcrm_list_meetings
tools.description: List meetings between two dates, optionally for one user. GET /Meetings.

tools.name: webcrm_list_support_cases
tools.description: List support cases, one page at a time. GET /SupportCases.

tools.name: webcrm_get_support_case
tools.description: Get one support case by id. GET /SupportCases/{id}.

tools.name: webcrm_list_users
tools.description: List webCRM users (sales and service staff), one page at a time. GET /Users.

tools.name: webcrm_list_pipelines
tools.description: List the sales pipelines and their levels. GET /Pipelines.

tools.name: webcrm_list_products
tools.description: List products (catalogue items), one page at a time. GET /Products.

tools.name: webcrm_get_field_metadata
tools.description: Describe the fields of one or more entity types, including custom fields. GET /FieldsMetadata/{entityTypes}.
